In this video, we'll be talking about the dark side and scams of the internet, and how to protect yourself from them. We'll be discussing cyber security, data privacy in India, infotainment, and more!

If you're interested in learning more about cyber security or simply want to be more informed about the internet, then this video is for you! We'll be discussing the dark side of the internet, as well as some of the most common scams and scams of the internet. So make sure to watch it, and stay safe online!

In the digital age, our online presence is both a boon and a vulnerability. In "Dark Side & Scams Of The Internet: Cyber Security Explained," Ashutosh Pratihast sheds light on the perilous world of cyber scams. This eye-opening video unravels the sinister techniques employed by scammers, exposing their intricate web of deception.

From cunning scam calls that prey on unsuspecting individuals, to the insidious realm of WhatsApp fraud calls, every facet of cyber malfeasance is dissected. The video delves into the alarming rise of sextortion, a method wherein victims are coerced under threat of defamatory exposure. QR Code scams, a relatively new but highly effective avenue for exploitation, are also demystified.

The heart of the matter lies in phishing scams, a pervasive threat that masquerades as legitimate entities to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information. Ashutosh Pratihast equips viewers with invaluable insights into recognizing and thwarting these treacherous ploys.

As the digital landscape evolves, so do the tactics of cybercriminals. This video is a beacon of awareness, illuminating the path toward safeguarding oneself from falling prey to these malevolent practices. Arm yourself with knowledge and stay one step ahead of the scammers.

Don't miss this opportunity to fortify your cyber defenses. Watch "Dark Side & Scams Of The Internet: Cyber Security Explained" now, and empower yourself with the knowledge to navigate the digital realm securely.
